The Authentic Name

Scholarly reference for Quánzhēn

Chinese characters

全真

The name in its original Chinese characters form. 全真 carries the full phonetic and orthographic weight of the source tradition.

ASCII Constraint

QUANZHEN

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

Quánzhēn

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
quánzhēn.com → xn--qunzhn-qta71b.com

The non-ASCII characters in Quánzhēn are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is Quánzhēn. PUNICODEX does not claim this domain is available; always verify status with a registrar.

Tier Classification

Why Quánzhēn is classified as Tier-1 Full

The Ancient name 全真 is represented by its most canonical scholarly spelling. For non-Greek names, Tier-1 status reflects the definitive attested restoration rather than Greek-style stress/length features. This is the authoritative Unicode form — a single-tier Tier-1 name.

Stress
Preserved
Acute or circumflex accent marks the pitch stress of the original.
Length
Preserved
Macron (ō, ē, ā) marks long vowels from the original.
Dual Variant
Yes
Both stress and length create multiple valid scholarly restorations.
